result.title: Graph Signal Generation via Graph-Aware Diffusion Models
result.comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence. Code: https://github.com/vimalkb7/SpectralAnalysisGAD
result.summary: Many signals are defined on the nodes of a graph, such as traffic flow at road sensors or user purchases of related products. They are often partly observed, and learning their distribution enables imputing missing values and forecasting future ones. Diffusion models learn such distributions, but their forward noise is independent across nodes and does not depend on the graph. We introduce graph-aware diffusion (GAD), whose forward process is a heat diffusion on the graph driven by Gaussian noise. In the graph Fourier basis, the forward transition is a scalar Gaussian channel at each frequency. With a shared diffusion rate, high graph frequencies are attenuated faster than low ones. We propose Mode-Adaptive SNR Scheduling (MASS), which assigns each graph frequency its own diffusion rate and keeps all of them at the same SNR. For graph-stationary signals, MASS equalizes the normalized error of the optimal linear denoiser across frequencies. We bound reverse-SDE stiffness as a function of the (shifted) Laplacian's condition number, with a logarithmic upper bound for MASS and a linear lower bound for shared rates. GAD with MASS improves recommendation accuracy by 5-19%, reduces traffic-imputation RMSE by up to 7.8% with half as many reverse steps, and improves forecasting MAE and RMSE using only 3 reverse steps.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 graph-aware diffusion（GAD），把前向加噪改为图上的热扩散，并设计 Mode-Adaptive SNR Scheduling（MASS），为各图频率分配独立扩散率并保持相同 SNR，同时给出反向 SDE 刚性随 Laplacian 条件数变化的界，在推荐、交通插补与预测任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 按频率自适应的噪声调度与反向步数效率（仅需 3 步）可能为 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态生成中的调度和计算预算分配提供线索，但需核查其图结构假设能否对应视觉推理中的表示结构。
